## 更新内容 / Changes

- 复制实例默认改为“仅迁移会话”，只迁移 Codex 会话记录、会话索引、归档会话和项目分组状态，避免复制缓存、技能、桌面状态、登录凭据和其他大型配置目录。
- 保留“完整复制（高级）”选项，需要完整配置快照时仍可使用。
- 复制后的实例按当前电脑语言重新初始化 Codex 界面，并重新生成当前实例的连接配置和模型目录；在支持的 Codex 版本中保留 Ultra 推理档位。
- 复制进度明确显示迁移模式、文件数量和大小，并补充大配置目录、外部数据库和中文语言 / Ultra 能力的回归测试。

- Instance duplication now defaults to **session-only migration**. It transfers Codex conversation records, indexes, archived sessions and project grouping state without copying caches, skills, desktop state, login credentials or other large configuration trees.
- **Full copy (advanced)** remains available for users who need a complete configuration snapshot.
- Copied instances reinitialize the Codex UI using the current computer language and regenerate instance-local connection configuration and the model catalog; Ultra reasoning remains available on supported Codex versions.
- Copy progress now reports the migration mode, file count and size, with regression coverage for large profile directories, external databases, Chinese locale detection and Ultra capability preservation.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。升级前退出应用，再安装新版；账号、实例与本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Quit the app before installing an update; accounts, instances and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）为计划功能，尚未接入。桌面菜单和语言适配取决于 Codex 版本，Fast 还取决于模型和服务商能力。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are planned, not implemented. Desktop menu and language integration depend on the Codex version; Fast also depends on the model and provider.
